questions.title: Combining Date And Time

questions.Option2: d + t — dates and times add directly
questions.Option4: datetime(d, t) — the constructor accepts them positionally

questions.codesnippet:
from datetime import date, timedelta

questions.title: Year Bound Overflow
questions.description: What does this snippet print?
questions.Option1: OverflowError — date(9999, 12, 31) is the maximum representable date
questions.Option3: ValueError — timedelta refuses to cross year boundaries
questions.Option4: date(10000, 1, 1) — Python widens the year range automatically

questions.codesnippet:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
dep = datetime(2024, 12, 31, 22, 45)
arr = dep + timedelta(hours=4)
print(arr.strftime("%d %b %Y %H:%M"))
questions.title: Cross Year Arrival Format
questions.description: What does this snippet print?
questions.Option1: 01 Jan 2025 02:45 — the arrival rolls into the next year, %b gives the short English month
questions.Option2: 31 Dec 2024 26:45 — the hour field runs past 24

questions.codesnippet:
from datetime import datetime
d = datetime.strptime("15 Aug 2024", "%d %b %Y")
print(d.strftime("%A"))
print(d.weekday())
